# INITIAL SETUP

```{r setup}
# Loads packages and sets the figure device.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, dev = "emf", fig.ext = "emf", dpi = 300)

rm(list = ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(devEMF)   # knitr looks the device up by name
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest) # must load after lme4
library(car)
library(DHARMa)
library(survival)
library(GLMMadaptive) # must load after lme4

figure_dir <- "../figures"
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Saves a figure to ../figures as PNG and EMF at the chunk's figure size.
save_figure <- function(plot, name) {
  width  <- knitr::opts_current$get("fig.width")
  height <- knitr::opts_current$get("fig.height")
  ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0(name, ".emf")), plot,
         width = width, height = height,
         device = function(filename, ...) devEMF::emf(file = filename, ...))
}
```

# STUDY DESIGN

Each participant was recorded under three DC conditions (Depolarising, Hyperpolarising and
No DC) at 25 Hz.

# DATA IMPORT

```{r import}
# Reads the DC exports and artefact tags, and drops the excluded participant.
dc_data_dir <- "../outputs/data"

dc_pulse_data       <- read.csv(file.path(dc_data_dir, "dc analysis.csv"))
dc_recruitment_data <- read.csv(file.path(dc_data_dir, "dc recruitment curve.csv"))
dc_tagged_areas     <- read.csv(file.path(dc_data_dir, "dctaggedareas.csv"))

dc_excluded_subjects <- "S03"
stopifnot(all(dc_excluded_subjects %in% dc_pulse_data$subjID))

dc_pulse_data       <- subset(dc_pulse_data, !(subjID %in% dc_excluded_subjects))
dc_recruitment_data <- subset(dc_recruitment_data, !(subjID %in% dc_excluded_subjects))
dc_tagged_areas     <- subset(dc_tagged_areas, !(subjID %in% dc_excluded_subjects))

dc_noise_channels <- c("ADMpk2pk", "SNAPpk2pk", "filtSNAPpk2pk")

stopifnot(all(dc_pulse_data$freq == 25))

dc_file_map <- unique(dc_pulse_data[c("filename", "subjID", "DC")])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dc_file_map$filename))
```

# ARTEFACT TAGS

```{r artefact-tags}
# Flags every pulse inside a tagged artefact window, per channel group.
dc_tag_channel_map <- list(
  ADM   = c("ADMpk2pk", "ADMarea", "ADMpk1T", "ADMpk2T"),
  SNAP  = c("SNAPpk2pk", "SNAParea", "SNAPpk1T", "SNAPpk2T",
            "filtSNAPpk2pk", "filtSNAParea", "filtSNAPpk1T", "filtSNAPpk2T"),
  elbow = character(0))

dc_tag_flags <- intersect(names(dc_tagged_areas), names(dc_tag_channel_map))

# Whole-channel exclusions, by subject. Currently none.
dc_channel_exclusions <- data.frame(
  subjID  = character(0),
  channel = character(0),
  reason  = character(0),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

dc_channel_columns <- list(
  ADMpk2pk      = c("ADMpk2pk", "ADMarea", "ADMpk1T", "ADMpk2T"),
  SNAPpk2pk     = c("SNAPpk2pk", "SNAParea", "SNAPpk1T", "SNAPpk2T"),
  filtSNAPpk2pk = c("filtSNAPpk2pk", "filtSNAParea", "filtSNAPpk1T", "filtSNAPpk2T"))

dc_pulse_tagged <- vapply(dc_tag_flags, function(flag) {
  hit <- rep(FALSE, nrow(dc_pulse_data))
  w <- dc_tagged_areas[dc_tagged_areas[[flag]] == 1, ]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(w)))
    hit <- hit | (dc_pulse_data$filename == w$filename[i] &
                  dc_pulse_data$fileStimTime >= w$start[i] &
                  dc_pulse_data$fileStimTime <= w$end[i])
  hit
}, logical(nrow(dc_pulse_data)))
dc_pulse_tagged <- as.data.frame(dc_pulse_tagged)
```

# NOISE SUBTRACTION

```{r noise-subtracted-export}
# Subtracts each recording's 2 mA noise floor, blanks tagged pulses and writes
# ../outputs/data/noisereduceddcdata.csv.
dc_noise_current_ma <- 2

# The sort by `count` makes `duplicated()` keep the first 2 mA rung.
dc_noise_rows <- subset(dc_recruitment_data,
                        currAmp == dc_noise_current_ma & DCamp == 0)
dc_noise_rows <- dc_noise_rows[order(dc_noise_rows$filename, dc_noise_rows$count), ]
dc_noise_floor <- dc_noise_rows[!duplicated(dc_noise_rows$filename),
                                c("filename", dc_noise_channels)]

dc_noise_index <- match(dc_pulse_data$filename, dc_noise_floor$filename)
stopifnot(!anyNA(dc_noise_index))

dc_noise_reduced_data <- dc_pulse_data
for (ch in dc_noise_channels)
  dc_noise_reduced_data[[ch]] <-
    pmax(dc_noise_reduced_data[[ch]] - dc_noise_floor[[ch]][dc_noise_index], 0)

for (flag in dc_tag_flags) {
  cols <- dc_tag_channel_map[[flag]]
  if (!length(cols)) next
  dc_noise_reduced_data[dc_pulse_tagged[[flag]], cols] <- NA
}

dc_noise_reduced_data$artefact_channels <- apply(dc_pulse_tagged, 1, function(x)
  paste(dc_tag_flags[x], collapse = "|"))

dc_pulse_excluded <- setNames(
  lapply(dc_noise_channels, function(ch) {
    subs <- dc_channel_exclusions$subjID[dc_channel_exclusions$channel == ch]
    dc_pulse_data$subjID %in% subs
  }), dc_noise_channels)

for (ch in dc_noise_channels) {
  hit <- dc_pulse_excluded[[ch]]
  if (!any(hit)) next
  dc_noise_reduced_data[hit, dc_channel_columns[[ch]]] <- NA
}

dc_noise_reduced_data$excluded_channels <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(dc_noise_reduced_data)), function(i)
    paste(dc_noise_channels[vapply(dc_pulse_excluded, `[`, logical(1), i)],
          collapse = "|"), character(1))

write.csv(dc_noise_reduced_data, "../outputs/data/noisereduceddcdata.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# NORMALISATION

```{r normalise}
# Builds `dc_train_data` (one row per train pulse, normalised to the pre-train singles)
# and `dc_train_sec_means` (one row per recording x second).
dc_train_data <- subset(dc_noise_reduced_data, measure == "Train")

# `count` is a pulse index; train time is reconstructed from it.
dc_train_data$time_s <- dc_train_data$count / dc_train_data$freq
dc_train_data$second <- ceiling(dc_train_data$count / dc_train_data$freq)

dc_singles_rows <- subset(dc_noise_reduced_data, measure == "Singles")

dc_safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

dc_singles_baseline <- aggregate(dc_singles_rows[dc_noise_channels],
                                 list(filename = dc_singles_rows$filename), dc_safe_mean)
stopifnot(all(table(dc_singles_rows$filename) == 5))

dc_train_data <- merge(dc_train_data, dc_singles_baseline,
                       by = "filename", suffixes = c("", "_baseline"))
for (ch in dc_noise_channels)
  dc_train_data[[paste0(ch, "_norm")]] <-
    dc_train_data[[ch]] / dc_train_data[[paste0(ch, "_baseline")]]

# `merge` sorts by filename; restore delivery order.
dc_train_data <- dc_train_data[order(dc_train_data$filename, dc_train_data$count), ]

dc_norm_channels <- paste0(dc_noise_channels, "_norm")
dc_train_sec_means <- aggregate(dc_train_data[dc_norm_channels],
                                list(filename = dc_train_data$filename,
                                     second   = dc_train_data$second),
                                dc_safe_mean)

dc_train_sec_means$time_s <- dc_train_sec_means$second - 0.5
dc_train_sec_means <- merge(dc_train_sec_means, dc_file_map, by = "filename")
dc_train_sec_means <- dc_train_sec_means[order(dc_train_sec_means$filename,
                                               dc_train_sec_means$second), ]
stopifnot(all(table(dc_train_sec_means$filename) == 240))
```

## Figure settings

```{r plot-setup}
# Shared figure settings: colours, labels, theme, y limits and legend text.
dc_condition_colours <- c(Depolarising    = "#eb6834",
                          Hyperpolarising = "#2a78d6",
                          `No DC`         = "#0b0b0b")
dc_condition_linetypes <- c(Depolarising = "solid", Hyperpolarising = "solid",
                            `No DC` = "dashed")
dc_condition_order <- c("Depolarising", "Hyperpolarising", "No DC")

dc_channel_labels <- c(ADMpk2pk      = "ADM CMAP (motor)",
                       SNAPpk2pk     = "SNAP (sensory)",
                       filtSNAPpk2pk = "filtered SNAP (sensory)")

axis_linewidth <- 0.8
line_axis      <- axis_linewidth
line_data      <- 0.5
line_baseline  <- 0.5
line_summary   <- 0.4
line_reference <- 0.3
line_trace     <- 0.25

manuscript_theme <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.line   = element_line(linewidth = axis_linewidth, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks  = element_line(linewidth = axis_linewidth, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3.5, "pt"),
      axis.title  = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text   = element_text(size = base_size - 2, colour = "black"),
      plot.title    = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size - 3.5),
      plot.caption  = element_text(size = base_size - 4.5, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0),
      legend.title  = element_text(size = base_size - 2),
      legend.text   = element_text(size = base_size - 3),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "lines"))
}

baseline_hline <- function(yintercept = 1) {
  geom_hline(yintercept = yintercept, linewidth = line_baseline, colour = "grey50")
}

title_case_label <- function(x) gsub("\\b([a-z])", "\\U\\1", x, perl = TRUE)

dc_ylab_norm <- function(ch) paste0(title_case_label(dc_channel_labels[[ch]]),
                                    "\nNormalised Peak-to-Peak Response")

dc_shared_y_channels <- "filtSNAPpk2pk"
dc_shared_y_ratio_cut <- 1.5

dc_family_y_max <- function(df, ch, value_col, channel_col = "channel", pad = 1.05) {
  shared_rows <- df[[channel_col]] %in% dc_shared_y_channels
  stopifnot(any(shared_rows))
  m_shared <- max(df[[value_col]][shared_rows], na.rm = TRUE)
  m_all    <- max(df[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (m_all <= dc_shared_y_ratio_cut * m_shared) return(m_all * pad)
  if (ch %in% dc_shared_y_channels) return(m_shared * pad)
  max(df[[value_col]][df[[channel_col]] == ch], na.rm = TRUE) * pad
}

# Y breaks from 0 that always include 1.
baseline_breaks <- function(y_max, target_ticks = 6) {
  candidates <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5, 1)
  inc <- candidates[which.min(abs(y_max / candidates - target_ticks))]
  seq(0, ceiling(y_max / inc) * inc, by = inc)
}

dc_channel_short <- c(ADMpk2pk      = "Motor",
                      SNAPpk2pk     = "Sensory (unfiltered)",
                      filtSNAPpk2pk = "Sensory")

dc_figure_channels <- c("ADMpk2pk", "filtSNAPpk2pk")
dc_figure_channel_names <- c(ADMpk2pk = "motor", filtSNAPpk2pk = "sensory")

dc_subject_order <- sort(unique(dc_train_data$subjID))

dc_train_data$DC <- factor(dc_train_data$DC, levels = dc_condition_order)
dc_train_sec_means$DC <- factor(dc_train_sec_means$DC, levels = dc_condition_order)

# DC offset per recording.
dc_offset_ma <- vapply(split(dc_train_data$DCamp, dc_train_data$filename),
  function(x) as.numeric(names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]), numeric(1))
dc_group_label <- function(cond) {
  if (cond == "No DC") return("No DC")
  v <- dc_offset_ma[dc_file_map$filename[dc_file_map$DC == cond]]
  sprintf("%s (%s-%s mA)", cond, format(min(v)), format(max(v)))
}
```

## Recovery dataset

```{r build-dc-recovery}
# Builds `dc_recovery_data`: one row per recovery probe, normalised to the pre-train singles.
dc_recovery_data <- subset(dc_noise_reduced_data, measure == "Recovery")

dc_train_end_time <- tapply(dc_train_data$fileStimTime, dc_train_data$filename, max)

# Drops a probe exported twice on the same timestamp.
dc_recovery_duplicate <- duplicated(dc_recovery_data[c("filename", "fileStimTime")])
stopifnot(all(table(dc_recovery_data$filename[dc_recovery_duplicate]) <= 1))
dc_recovery_data <- dc_recovery_data[!dc_recovery_duplicate, ]

dc_recovery_data$time_s   <- dc_recovery_data$fileStimTime -
                             dc_train_end_time[dc_recovery_data$filename]
dc_recovery_data$time_min <- dc_recovery_data$time_s / 60
stopifnot(all(dc_recovery_data$time_s > 0))

dc_recovery_baseline_row <- match(dc_recovery_data$filename, dc_singles_baseline$filename)
stopifnot(!anyNA(dc_recovery_baseline_row))
for (ch in dc_noise_channels)
  dc_recovery_data[[paste0(ch, "_norm")]] <-
    dc_recovery_data[[ch]] / dc_singles_baseline[[ch]][dc_recovery_baseline_row]

# Probe index within each recording.
dc_recovery_data$probe <- with(dc_recovery_data,
                               ave(time_s, filename, FUN = function(t) rank(t)))

dc_recovery_data$DC <- factor(dc_recovery_data$DC, levels = dc_condition_order)

dc_recovery_data <- dc_recovery_data[order(dc_recovery_data$filename,
                                           dc_recovery_data$time_s), ]
```

## Group means

```{r build-group-means}
# Builds `dc_train_group_means` and `dc_recovery_group_means`.
dc_train_group_means <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  col <- paste0(ch, "_norm")
  do.call(rbind, lapply(
    split(dc_train_sec_means, list(dc_train_sec_means$DC, dc_train_sec_means$second),
          drop = TRUE),
    function(d) {
      v <- d[[col]][!is.na(d[[col]])]
      if (length(v) < 2) return(NULL)
      m <- mean(v); se <- sd(v) / sqrt(length(v))
      data.frame(channel = ch, DC = d$DC[1], second = d$second[1], time_s = d$second[1] - 0.5,
                 n = length(v), mean = m,
                 lo = m - qt(0.975, length(v) - 1) * se,
                 hi = m + qt(0.975, length(v) - 1) * se)
    }))
}))
dc_train_group_means <- dc_train_group_means[
  order(dc_train_group_means$channel, dc_train_group_means$DC,
        dc_train_group_means$second), ]
stopifnot(all(table(dc_train_group_means$channel, dc_train_group_means$DC) == 240))

dc_group_legend_labels <- vapply(dc_condition_order, dc_group_label, character(1))

dc_recovery_group_means <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  col <- paste0(ch, "_norm")
  do.call(rbind, lapply(
    split(dc_recovery_data, list(dc_recovery_data$DC, dc_recovery_data$probe), drop = TRUE),
    function(d) {
      v <- d[[col]][!is.na(d[[col]])]
      if (length(v) < 2) return(NULL)
      m <- mean(v); se <- sd(v) / sqrt(length(v))
      data.frame(channel = ch, DC = d$DC[1], probe = d$probe[1],
                 time_min = mean(d$time_min),
                 n = length(v), mean = m,
                 lo = m - qt(0.975, length(v) - 1) * se,
                 hi = m + qt(0.975, length(v) - 1) * se)
    }))
}))
dc_recovery_group_means <- dc_recovery_group_means[
  order(dc_recovery_group_means$channel, dc_recovery_group_means$DC,
        dc_recovery_group_means$probe), ]

dc_recovery_n_probes <- 18
stopifnot(all(table(dc_recovery_group_means$channel, dc_recovery_group_means$DC) ==
                dc_recovery_n_probes))

dc_recovery_window_end_min <- max(dc_recovery_data$time_min)
```

## End-of-train asymptotes and models

```{r build-asymptotes}
# Builds `dc_train_asymptotes`: one row per recording, the end-of-train ratio per channel.
dc_asymptote_window_s <- 5

dc_train_asymptotes <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(dc_train_sec_means$filename)),
  function(f) {
    d <- dc_train_sec_means[dc_train_sec_means$filename == f, ]
    d <- d[d$second > max(d$second) - dc_asymptote_window_s, ]
    out <- data.frame(filename = f, window_seconds = nrow(d))
    for (ch in dc_figure_channels)
      out[[ch]] <- dc_safe_mean(d[[paste0(ch, "_norm")]])
    out
  }))
stopifnot(all(dc_train_asymptotes$window_seconds == dc_asymptote_window_s))

dc_train_asymptotes <- merge(dc_train_asymptotes, dc_file_map, by = "filename")

dc_asymptote_order <- c("Hyperpolarising", "No DC", "Depolarising")
dc_train_asymptotes$DC <- factor(dc_train_asymptotes$DC, levels = dc_asymptote_order)
dc_train_asymptotes <- dc_train_asymptotes[order(dc_train_asymptotes$DC,
                                                 dc_train_asymptotes$subjID), ]
```

```{r asymptote-models}
# Fits the end-of-train models and builds the marginal means and omnibus tests.
dc_asymptote_motor_data   <- dc_train_asymptotes[!is.na(dc_train_asymptotes$ADMpk2pk), ]
dc_asymptote_sensory_data <- dc_train_asymptotes[!is.na(dc_train_asymptotes$filtSNAPpk2pk), ]

dc_asymptote_models <- list(
  ADMpk2pk      = lmer(ADMpk2pk ~ DC + (1|subjID),
                       data = dc_asymptote_motor_data),
  filtSNAPpk2pk = lmer(filtSNAPpk2pk ~ DC + (1|subjID),
                       data = dc_asymptote_sensory_data))

dc_asymptote_emmeans <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(dc_asymptote_models), function(ch) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(emmeans(dc_asymptote_models[[ch]], ~ DC)))
  s$channel <- ch
  s
}))

# lmerTest's anova with Kenward-Roger df, as emmeans uses.
dc_asymptote_tests <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(dc_asymptote_models), function(ch) {
  a <- anova(dc_asymptote_models[[ch]], ddf = "Kenward-Roger")
  data.frame(channel = ch,
             f      = a[["F value"]][1],
             num_df = a[["NumDF"]][1],
             den_df = a[["DenDF"]][1],
             p      = a[["Pr(>F)"]][1],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

format_p_label <- function(p) {
  if (!is.finite(p)) return("p = NA")
  if (p < 0.001) return("p < 0.001")
  paste0("p = ", sprintf(paste0("%.", max(0, 1 - floor(log10(p))), "f"), p))
}

```

# RAW WAVEFORM TRACES

Raw Spike2 waveforms from the start and end of the train for three recordings.

```{r dc-raw-traces, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4}
# Builds the raw trace figures.
dc_raw_trace_files <- c(
  "depolarising, train start"      = "../outputs/data/dc_trace_depolarising_train_start.txt",
  "depolarising, train end"        = "../outputs/data/dc_trace_depolarising_train_end.txt",
  "hyperpolarising 1, train start" = "../outputs/data/dc_trace_hyperpolarising_1_train_start.txt",
  "hyperpolarising 1, train end"   = "../outputs/data/dc_trace_hyperpolarising_1_train_end.txt",
  "hyperpolarising 2, train start" = "../outputs/data/dc_trace_hyperpolarising_2_train_start.txt",
  "hyperpolarising 2, train end"   = "../outputs/data/dc_trace_hyperpolarising_2_train_end.txt")

dc_raw_trace_channels <- c("ADM", "filt_SNAP")
dc_raw_trace_ylim_mv <- list(ADM = 1, filt_SNAP = 0.03)
dc_raw_trace_channel_labels <- c(
  ADM       = "ADM CMAP\n(motor)",
  filt_SNAP = "filtered SNAP\n(sensory)")

# Parses a Spike2 text export into waveform samples and event times.
dc_read_spike2_text <- function(path) {
  lines  <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  starts <- grep('^"CHANNEL"', lines)
  stopifnot(length(starts) > 0)
  ends <- c(starts[-1] - 1, length(lines))

  waveforms <- list(); events <- list()

  for (b in seq_along(starts)) {
    block    <- lines[starts[b]:ends[b]]
    unquote  <- function(x) gsub('^"|"$', "", trimws(x))
    ch_type  <- unquote(block[2])
    ch_title <- unquote(block[4])
    numeric_line <- suppressWarnings(!is.na(as.numeric(trimws(block))))

    if (ch_type == "Waveform") {
      start_line <- grep('^"START"', block)
      stopifnot(length(start_line) == 1)
      start_fields <- strsplit(block[start_line], "\t")[[1]]
      t0 <- as.numeric(start_fields[2]); dt <- as.numeric(start_fields[3])
      mv <- as.numeric(trimws(block[numeric_line & seq_along(block) > start_line]))
      waveforms[[ch_title]] <- data.frame(
        channel = ch_title,
        time_s  = t0 + (seq_along(mv) - 1) * dt,
        mv      = mv,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    } else if (ch_type == "Evt+") {
      events[[ch_title]] <- as.numeric(trimws(block[numeric_line & seq_along(block) > 4]))
    }
  }

  list(waveforms = do.call(rbind, waveforms), events = events)
}

dc_raw_traces <- lapply(dc_raw_trace_files, dc_read_spike2_text)

# Source recording from each export's header, and its figure label and dose.
dc_raw_trace_source <- vapply(dc_raw_trace_files, function(p) {
  info <- gsub('^"|"$', "", trimws(readLines(p, n = 2, warn = FALSE)[2]))
  sub("\\.smrx$", "", info)
}, character(1))
stopifnot(all(dc_raw_trace_source %in% dc_pulse_data$filename))

dc_raw_trace_meta <- lapply(dc_raw_trace_source, function(src) {
  p <- subset(dc_pulse_data, filename == src & measure == "Train")
  list(
    figure_label = paste0("Individual Participant - ", as.character(p$DC[1])),
    dose         = sprintf("%g mA DC, %g mA pulses, %g Hz",
                    as.numeric(names(sort(table(p$DCamp),   decreasing = TRUE))[1]),
                    as.numeric(names(sort(table(p$currAmp), decreasing = TRUE))[1]),
                    p$freq[1]))
})
names(dc_raw_trace_meta) <- names(dc_raw_trace_files)

dc_raw_trace_plot <- function(trace, window_label, source_label, dose_label) {

  w <- trace$waveforms[trace$waveforms$channel %in% dc_raw_trace_channels, ]
  stim_times <- trace$events[["trigger"]]
  t_zero <- min(stim_times)

  channel_order <- intersect(dc_raw_trace_channels, unique(w$channel))
  w$channel <- factor(w$channel, levels = channel_order)
  w$x <- (w$time_s - t_zero) * 1000
  stim_x  <- (stim_times - t_zero) * 1000
  x_range <- c(0, max(w$x))

  panels <- lapply(seq_along(channel_order), function(i) {
    ch      <- channel_order[i]
    is_last <- i == length(channel_order)
    d       <- w[w$channel == ch, ]
    cap     <- dc_raw_trace_ylim_mv[[ch]]

    p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = x, y = mv)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = stim_x, linetype = "dotted",
                 linewidth = line_reference, colour = "grey55") +
      baseline_hline(0) +
      geom_line(linewidth = line_trace, colour = "grey15") +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = x_range, ylim = c(-cap, cap), expand = FALSE) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty(c(-cap, cap), n = 4)) +
      labs(x = if (is_last) "Time from first stimulus (ms)" else NULL,
           y = dc_raw_trace_channel_labels[[ch]]) +
      manuscript_theme() +
      theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9))

    if (!is_last)
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                     axis.line.x = element_blank())
    p
  })

  stack <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = panels, ncol = 1, align = "v", axis = "lr",
                              rel_heights = c(rep(1, length(panels) - 1), 1.3))

  header_text <- paste0(source_label, " - ", window_label)

  sub_text <- sprintf(
    paste("%s | %d channels at %g kHz, amplitude in mV, %d stimuli |",
          "dotted lines = stimulus instants"),
    dose_label, length(channel_order), round(1 / diff(w$time_s[1:2]) / 1000, 1),
    length(stim_times))

  cap_text <- paste(sprintf("%s +/-%g", channel_order,
                            unlist(dc_raw_trace_ylim_mv[channel_order])),
                    collapse = ", ")
  lead_ms <- (t_zero - min(w$time_s)) * 1000
  lead_text <- if (lead_ms > 0.5)
    sprintf(paste("The export carries %.0f ms before the first stimulus; the axis starts",
                  "at the stimulus, so that baseline is present in the data but not",
                  "shown."), lead_ms)
  else
    "The export begins at the first stimulus, so there is no pre-stimulus baseline."

  cap_full <- paste(strwrap(paste0(
    "Spike2 text export, un-normalised and NOT noise-subtracted. Y limits are FIXED per ",
    "channel (", cap_text, " mV) and traces are clipped at them, so a deflection reaching ",
    "the panel edge is larger than shown - the stimulus artefact in the first ~2 ms of ",
    "each sweep is the main one. Panel heights are NOT comparable between channels. ",
    lead_text),
    width = 118), collapse = "\n")

  header <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_label(header_text, x = 0.01, y = 0.72, hjust = 0, size = 12) +
    cowplot::draw_label(sub_text, x = 0.01, y = 0.28, hjust = 0,
                        size = 8.5, colour = "grey25")
  footer <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_label(cap_full, x = 0.01, y = 0.5, hjust = 0,
                        size = 7.5, colour = "grey35")

  footer_rel <- 0.06 * length(strsplit(cap_full, "\n")[[1]])

  cowplot::plot_grid(header, stack, footer, ncol = 1,
                     rel_heights = c(0.15, 1, footer_rel))
}

for (nm in names(dc_raw_traces)) {
  p <- dc_raw_trace_plot(dc_raw_traces[[nm]],
                         sub("^[^,]*, ", "", nm),
                         dc_raw_trace_meta[[nm]]$figure_label,
                         dc_raw_trace_meta[[nm]]$dose)
  print(p)
  save_figure(p, sub("^dc_trace", "dc_raw_trace",
                     sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(dc_raw_trace_files[[nm]]))))
}
```

# END-OF-TRAIN RATIO BY CONDITION

Each recording's mean over its last 5 seconds of train, relative to its pre-train singles.

```{r asymptote-scatter, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6.5}
# Builds the end-of-train scatter figures, one per channel, with a broken y axis where an
# outlier needs one.
dc_subject_colours <- setNames(hcl.colors(length(dc_subject_order), "Dark 3"),
                               dc_subject_order)

dc_train_asymptotes$x <- as.integer(dc_train_asymptotes$DC)

dc_dodge_width <- 0.1
dc_subject_offsets <- setNames(
  seq(-dc_dodge_width / 2, dc_dodge_width / 2, length.out = length(dc_subject_order)),
  dc_subject_order)

dc_train_asymptotes$x_pos <- dc_train_asymptotes$x +
                             dc_subject_offsets[dc_train_asymptotes$subjID]

dc_q1 <- function(x) quantile(x, 0.25, names = FALSE)
dc_q3 <- function(x) quantile(x, 0.75, names = FALSE)

# Piecewise-linear y transform that compresses (lo, hi) into a band of height `gap`.
dc_break_transform <- function(lo, hi, gap) {
  fwd <- function(x)
    ifelse(x <= lo, x,
           ifelse(x >= hi, lo + gap + (x - hi),
                  lo + gap * (x - lo) / (hi - lo)))
  inv <- function(y)
    ifelse(y <= lo, y,
           ifelse(y >= lo + gap, hi + (y - lo - gap),
                  lo + (y - lo) * (hi - lo) / gap))
  scales::new_transform("dc-break", transform = fwd, inverse = inv)
}

# Splits each subject's line into pieces, cut where a segment crosses the axis break, and
# returns the x of each cut at the middle of the break band.
dc_break_line_pieces <- function(df, lo, hi, gap) {
  fwd <- dc_break_transform(lo, hi, gap)$transform
  out <- list(); cut_x <- numeric(0); cut_s <- character(0)
  for (s in unique(df$subjID)) {
    d <- df[df$subjID == s, ]
    d <- d[order(d$x_pos), ]
    piece <- 1
    cur <- data.frame(x_pos = d$x_pos[1], y_plot = d$y_plot[1])
    for (k in seq_len(nrow(d))[-1]) {
      xa <- d$x_pos[k - 1]; ya <- d$y_plot[k - 1]
      xb <- d$x_pos[k];     yb <- d$y_plot[k]
      if ((ya >= hi && yb <= lo) || (ya <= lo && yb >= hi)) {
        ta <- fwd(ya); tb <- fwd(yb)
        x_at <- function(t) xa + (t - ta) / (tb - ta) * (xb - xa)
        y_end_a <- if (ya > yb) hi else lo
        y_end_b <- if (ya > yb) lo else hi
        cur <- rbind(cur, data.frame(x_pos = x_at(fwd(y_end_a)), y_plot = y_end_a))
        out[[length(out) + 1]] <- cbind(cur, subjID = s, piece = paste(s, piece))
        piece <- piece + 1
        cur <- data.frame(x_pos = x_at(fwd(y_end_b)), y_plot = y_end_b)
        cut_x <- c(cut_x, x_at(lo + gap / 2)); cut_s <- c(cut_s, s)
      }
      cur <- rbind(cur, data.frame(x_pos = xb, y_plot = yb))
    }
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- cbind(cur, subjID = s, piece = paste(s, piece))
  }
  list(lines = do.call(rbind, out),
       cuts  = data.frame(x = cut_x, subjID = cut_s, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}

dc_asymptote_lower_inc <- 0.25

# Largest value left after repeatedly dropping a point more than twice the next.
dc_inlier_max <- function(values) {
  v <- sort(values, decreasing = TRUE)
  keep <- v
  while (length(keep) > 1 && keep[1] > 2 * keep[2]) keep <- keep[-1]
  max(keep)
}

baseline_ratio <- 1

dc_asymptote_lower_top <- max(
  vapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch)
    dc_inlier_max(dc_train_asymptotes[[ch]][!is.na(dc_train_asymptotes[[ch]])]),
    numeric(1)),
  baseline_ratio) * 1.18

dc_asymptote_lower_breaks <- seq(
  0,
  floor(dc_asymptote_lower_top / dc_asymptote_lower_inc) * dc_asymptote_lower_inc,
  by = dc_asymptote_lower_inc)

dc_asymptote_y_labels <- scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)

for (ch in dc_figure_channels) {
  df <- dc_train_asymptotes[!is.na(dc_train_asymptotes[[ch]]), ]
  df$value <- df[[ch]]

  tst <- dc_asymptote_tests[dc_asymptote_tests$channel == ch, ]
  test_label <- paste0("effect of DC:\nF(", tst$num_df, ", ",
                       sprintf("%.1f", tst$den_df), ") = ",
                       sprintf("%.2f", tst$f), ", ", format_p_label(tst$p))

  df$above_break <- df$value > dc_inlier_max(df$value)
  has_break <- any(df$above_break)

  break_lo  <- if (has_break) dc_asymptote_lower_top else NA_real_
  break_hi  <- if (has_break) min(df$value[df$above_break]) - 0.05 * break_lo else NA_real_
  break_gap <- if (has_break) 0.06 * break_lo else NA_real_

  df$y_plot <- df$value

  line_pieces <- if (has_break) dc_break_line_pieces(df, break_lo, break_hi, break_gap)
  subject_line_data <- if (has_break) line_pieces$lines else transform(df, piece = subjID)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x_pos, y = y_plot, colour = subjID)) +
    baseline_hline() +
    geom_line(data = subject_line_data, aes(group = piece), linewidth = line_summary, alpha = 0.7,
              linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    # `oob_keep` stops the break marker, which straddles the panel edge, being dropped.
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(dc_asymptote_order),
                       labels = dc_asymptote_order,
                       limits = c(0.5, length(dc_asymptote_order) + 0.5),
                       expand = expansion(mult = 0.05),
                       oob    = scales::oob_keep) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = dc_subject_colours, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = test_label,
             hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.6, colour = "grey20",
             lineheight = 0.95) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s Response at End of Train", dc_channel_short[[ch]]),
         caption = sprintf(paste0("mean of the last %d s over the 5 pre-train singles; ",
                                  "n = %d subjects per condition\n",
                                  "every point is one recording; no model summary is drawn - ",
                                  "marginal means and their\nconfidence limits are reported ",
                                  "in the text\n",
                                  "top right: omnibus F test of the DC term in ",
                                  "lmer(~ DC + (1|subjID)) ",
                                  "(Kenward-Roger df);\npairwise contrasts between conditions ",
                                  "are reported in the text, not on the figure%s"),
                           dc_asymptote_window_s, length(unique(df$subjID)),
                           if (has_break)
                             sprintf(paste("\nY AXIS IS BROKEN between %.2f and %.2f:",
                                           "the two segments share a scale but are not",
                                           "continuous.\n%d recording(s) lie above the break."),
                                     break_lo, break_hi, sum(df$above_break)) else ""),
         x = NULL, y = dc_ylab_norm(ch), colour = NULL) +
    manuscript_theme() +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0))

  y_top <- if (has_break) max(df$y_plot) + 0.05 * break_lo else dc_asymptote_lower_top

  if (has_break) {
    upper_breaks <- sort(unique(round(df$value[df$above_break], 2)))
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(
      transform = dc_break_transform(break_lo, break_hi, break_gap),
      breaks = c(dc_asymptote_lower_breaks, upper_breaks),
      labels = dc_asymptote_y_labels,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = dc_asymptote_lower_breaks,
      labels = dc_asymptote_y_labels,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))
  }

  # Break marker: the y axis line is redrawn in two pieces with slashes across the gap.
  if (has_break) {
    tr      <- dc_break_transform(break_lo, break_hi, break_gap)
    band_t  <- break_lo + break_gap / 2
    slash   <- 0.45 * break_gap
    offset  <- 0.18 * break_gap
    slash_w <- 0.055
    dc_x_edge <- 0.5 - 0.05 * length(dc_asymptote_order)

    p <- p +
      theme(axis.line.y = element_blank()) +
      annotate("segment", x = dc_x_edge, xend = dc_x_edge, y = 0, yend = break_lo,
               linewidth = line_axis, colour = "black") +
      annotate("segment", x = dc_x_edge, xend = dc_x_edge, y = break_hi, yend = y_top,
               linewidth = line_axis, colour = "black") +
      annotate("segment",
               x    = dc_x_edge - slash_w, xend = dc_x_edge + slash_w,
               y    = tr$inverse(c(band_t - slash - offset, band_t - slash + offset)),
               yend = tr$inverse(c(band_t + slash - offset, band_t + slash + offset)),
               linewidth = line_axis, colour = "black")

    # The same slashes across each subject line where it is cut at the break.
    for (k in seq_len(nrow(line_pieces$cuts))) {
      cx <- line_pieces$cuts$x[k]
      p <- p +
        annotate("segment",
                 x    = cx - slash_w, xend = cx + slash_w,
                 y    = tr$inverse(c(band_t - slash - offset, band_t - slash + offset)),
                 yend = tr$inverse(c(band_t + slash - offset, band_t + slash + offset)),
                 linewidth = line_axis,
                 colour = dc_subject_colours[[line_pieces$cuts$subjID[k]]])
    }
  }

  p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_top),
                           clip = if (has_break) "off" else "on")
  print(p)
  save_figure(p, paste0("dc_end_of_train_scatter_", dc_figure_channel_names[[ch]]))

}
```

# TIME TO SUSTAINED RECOVERY

The time each recording took to recover to 90% of its pre-train baseline, by DC condition.

```{r dc-recovery-threshold-scatter, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.8}
# Builds `dc_recovery_threshold_times` and one recovery-time scatter figure per channel.
dc_recovery_threshold_ratio       <- 0.9
dc_recovery_threshold_consecutive <- 2

# Time of the first of `consecutive` probes that all exceed `threshold`, or NA.
dc_first_sustained_crossing <- function(value, time_min, threshold, consecutive) {
  above <- !is.na(value) & value > threshold
  n     <- length(above)
  if (n < consecutive) return(NA_real_)
  runs <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(seq_len(consecutive) - 1, function(k)
    above[seq(1 + k, n - consecutive + 1 + k)]))
  hit <- which(runs)
  if (!length(hit)) return(NA_real_)
  time_min[hit[1]]
}

dc_recovery_threshold_times <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(dc_recovery_data$filename)), function(f) {
    d <- dc_recovery_data[dc_recovery_data$filename == f, ]
    d <- d[order(d$time_min), ]
    v <- d[[paste0(ch, "_norm")]]
    if (all(is.na(v))) return(NULL)
    t_cross <- dc_first_sustained_crossing(v, d$time_min,
                                           dc_recovery_threshold_ratio,
                                           dc_recovery_threshold_consecutive)
    data.frame(
      channel  = ch,
      subjID   = d$subjID[1],
      DC       = as.character(d$DC[1]),
      filename = f,
      t_cross  = t_cross,
      censored = is.na(t_cross),
      never_depressed = !is.na(t_cross) && t_cross == d$time_min[1],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}))

dc_recovery_threshold_times$DC <- factor(dc_recovery_threshold_times$DC,
                                         levels = dc_asymptote_order)

# Censored recordings are plotted at the window end.
dc_recovery_threshold_times$y_plot <- ifelse(dc_recovery_threshold_times$censored,
                                             dc_recovery_window_end_min,
                                             dc_recovery_threshold_times$t_cross)

dc_recovery_threshold_times$x <- as.integer(dc_recovery_threshold_times$DC)
dc_recovery_threshold_times$x_pos <- dc_recovery_threshold_times$x +
  dc_subject_offsets[dc_recovery_threshold_times$subjID]

for (ch in dc_figure_channels) {
  df <- dc_recovery_threshold_times[dc_recovery_threshold_times$channel == ch, ]

  dc_threshold_n   <- table(df$DC)
  dc_threshold_cens <- tapply(df$censored, df$DC, sum)
  dc_threshold_cens[is.na(dc_threshold_cens)] <- 0

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x_pos, y = y_plot, colour = subjID)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = dc_recovery_window_end_min, linetype = "dotted",
               linewidth = line_reference, colour = "grey60") +
    stat_summary(aes(x = x, group = x),
                 fun = dc_q1, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6,
                 linewidth = line_summary, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
    stat_summary(aes(x = x, group = x),
                 fun = dc_q3, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6,
                 linewidth = line_summary, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
    stat_summary(aes(x = x, group = x),
                 fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6,
                 linewidth = line_summary, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_line(aes(group = subjID), linewidth = line_summary, alpha = 0.8,
              linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, !censored), size = 2) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, censored), shape = 2, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.7,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = dc_subject_colours, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(dc_asymptote_order),
                       labels = dc_asymptote_order,
                       limits = c(0.5, length(dc_asymptote_order) + 0.5)) +
    expand_limits(y = c(0, dc_recovery_window_end_min * 1.08)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 3, by = 0.5),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s Response: Time to Sustained Recovery",
                         dc_channel_short[[ch]]),
         caption = sprintf(paste0("first of %d consecutive probes above %.1f x pre-train ",
                                  "singles; n = %d subjects per condition\n",
                                  "grey bars: median (solid) with Q1 and Q3 (dashed)%s"),
                           dc_recovery_threshold_consecutive,
                           dc_recovery_threshold_ratio,
                           length(unique(df$subjID)),
                           if (any(dc_threshold_cens > 0))
                             sprintf(paste("\ntriangles = had not recovered by %.2f min",
                                           "(%s) - plotted at the window end,",
                                           "not measured there"),
                                     dc_recovery_window_end_min,
                                     paste0(names(dc_threshold_cens)[dc_threshold_cens > 0],
                                            ": ",
                                            as.integer(dc_threshold_cens[
                                              dc_threshold_cens > 0]), " of ",
                                            as.integer(dc_threshold_n[
                                              dc_threshold_cens > 0]),
                                            collapse = "; "))
                           else ""),
         x = NULL,
         y = sprintf("Time to sustained recovery above %.1f (min)",
                     dc_recovery_threshold_ratio),
         colour = NULL) +
    manuscript_theme() +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0))
  print(p)
  save_figure(p, paste0("dc_recovery_time_scatter_", dc_figure_channel_names[[ch]]))
}
```

```{r train-group-means-zoom, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4.5}
# Builds the zoomed end-of-train motor group-mean figure.
dc_zoom_window_s <- 60
dc_zoom_channel  <- "ADMpk2pk"
dc_zoom_y_max    <- 1.5

dc_zoom_data <- subset(dc_train_group_means,
                       channel == dc_zoom_channel &
                       second  > 240 - dc_zoom_window_s)
stopifnot(max(dc_zoom_data$mean) < dc_zoom_y_max)

dc_train_group_zoom_plot <-
  ggplot(dc_zoom_data, aes(x = time_s, y = mean, colour = DC, linetype = DC, fill = DC)) +
  baseline_hline() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.13, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = line_data) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dc_condition_colours, labels = dc_group_legend_labels,
                      drop = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = dc_condition_linetypes, labels = dc_group_legend_labels,
                        drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dc_condition_colours, labels = dc_group_legend_labels,
                    drop = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, dc_zoom_y_max)) +
  labs(title = sprintf("%s Response at the End of the Train",
                       dc_channel_short[[dc_zoom_channel]]),
       caption = sprintf(paste("last %d s only; mean of %d subjects with a t-based 95%% CI,",
                               "CLIPPED at y = %.1f (it reaches %.2f to %.2f).",
                               "\nNo pair of conditions has non-overlapping intervals at any",
                               "second here - the lines separate, the intervals do not."),
                         dc_zoom_window_s, max(dc_zoom_data$n), dc_zoom_y_max,
                         min(dc_zoom_data$lo), max(dc_zoom_data$hi)),
       x = "time from train onset (s)",
       y = dc_ylab_norm(dc_zoom_channel),
       colour = NULL, linetype = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  manuscript_theme() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(dc_train_group_zoom_plot)
save_figure(dc_train_group_zoom_plot,
            paste0("dc_group_mean_train_end_zoom_",
                   dc_figure_channel_names[[dc_zoom_channel]]))
```

## End-of-train model output

```{r asymptote-model-output}
# Prints the end-of-train marginal means, omnibus tests and medians by condition.
cat("estimated marginal means:\n")
print(dc_asymptote_emmeans[c("channel", "DC", "emmean", "lower.CL", "upper.CL")],
      row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

for (ch in names(dc_asymptote_models))
  if (isSingular(dc_asymptote_models[[ch]])) cat("\nWARNING:", ch, "model is a singular fit\n")

cat("\nomnibus effect of DC:\n")
print(data.frame(channel = dc_asymptote_tests$channel,
                 f       = signif(dc_asymptote_tests$f, 3),
                 num_df  = dc_asymptote_tests$num_df,
                 den_df  = round(dc_asymptote_tests$den_df, 1),
                 p       = signif(dc_asymptote_tests$p, 3)),
      row.names = FALSE)

for (ch in dc_figure_channels) {
  df <- dc_train_asymptotes[!is.na(dc_train_asymptotes[[ch]]), ]
  df$value <- df[[ch]]
  cat(sprintf("\n%s: median and quartiles by condition (n = %d each):\n",
              dc_channel_labels[[ch]], length(unique(df$subjID))))
  print(round(do.call(rbind, lapply(split(df$value, df$DC), function(x)
    c(Q1 = dc_q1(x), median = median(x), Q3 = dc_q3(x)))), 3))
}
```

## End-of-train model diagnostics

Residual diagnostics, the omnibus test and Tukey-adjusted pairwise contrasts for each
end-of-train model.

```{r asymptote-model-diagnostics}
# Prints diagnostics, the omnibus test and pairwise contrasts per end-of-train model.
for (ch in dc_figure_channels) {
  m <- dc_asymptote_models[[ch]]
  cat("\n================ ", dc_channel_labels[[ch]], " ================\n", sep = "")
  qqp(resid(m))
  plot(residuals(m) ~ predict(m, re.form = NA))
  dc_asymptote_simres <- simulateResiduals(m)
  plot(dc_asymptote_simres)
  print(testOutliers(dc_asymptote_simres))
  print(anova(m, ddf = "Kenward-Roger"))
  print(emmeans(m, pairwise ~ DC))
}
```

## Recovery-time model output

```{r dc-recovery-threshold-summary}
# Prints recovery times by channel and condition.
cat(sprintf("\ntime to %d consecutive probes above %.2f (min), by channel x condition:\n",
            dc_recovery_threshold_consecutive, dc_recovery_threshold_ratio))
for (ch in dc_figure_channels) {
  a <- dc_recovery_threshold_times[dc_recovery_threshold_times$channel == ch, ]
  cat(" ", ch, "\n")
  print(do.call(rbind, lapply(split(a, a$DC), function(x) data.frame(
    DC              = as.character(x$DC[1]),
    n               = nrow(x),
    reached         = sum(!x$censored),
    censored        = sum(x$censored),
    never_depressed = sum(x$never_depressed),
    median_min      = round(median(x$y_plot), 2),
    q1_min          = round(dc_q1(x$y_plot), 2),
    q3_min          = round(dc_q3(x$y_plot), 2)))),
    row.names = FALSE)
}
```

A censored-lognormal mixed model of recovery time by DC condition, per channel.

```{r dc-recovery-threshold-models}
# Fits the censored-lognormal models and builds the tests, marginal means, pairwise
# contrasts, fit checks and distribution checks.
dc_recovery_threshold_model_data <- dc_recovery_threshold_times

# Response is log(time) plus a censoring code: 0 exact, 2 right-censored.
dc_recovery_threshold_models <- setNames(lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  a <- subset(dc_recovery_threshold_model_data, channel == ch)
  a$resp <- cbind(log(a$y_plot), ifelse(a$censored, 2L, 0L))
  mixed_model(resp ~ DC, random = ~ 1 | subjID, data = a,
              family = censored.normal(), n_phis = 1)
}), dc_figure_channels)

# Back-transformed to minutes with `exp()`.
dc_recovery_threshold_emmeans <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  s  <- as.data.frame(summary(emmeans(dc_recovery_threshold_models[[ch]], ~ DC)))
  lo <- if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(s)) s$asymp.LCL else s$lower.CL
  hi <- if ("asymp.UCL" %in% names(s)) s$asymp.UCL else s$upper.CL
  data.frame(channel = ch, DC = as.character(s$DC),
             emmean = exp(s$emmean), lower.CL = exp(lo), upper.CL = exp(hi),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

dc_recovery_threshold_lrt <- function(null_fit, full_fit, df) {
  stat <- 2 * (as.numeric(logLik(full_fit)) - as.numeric(logLik(null_fit)))
  c(chisq = stat, p = pchisq(stat, df, lower.tail = FALSE))
}

dc_recovery_threshold_tests <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  a <- subset(dc_recovery_threshold_model_data, channel == ch)
  a$resp <- cbind(log(a$y_plot), ifelse(a$censored, 2L, 0L))
  m_null <- mixed_model(resp ~ 1, random = ~ 1 | subjID, data = a,
                        family = censored.normal(), n_phis = 1)
  df_dc <- length(levels(a$DC)) - 1
  t <- dc_recovery_threshold_lrt(m_null, dc_recovery_threshold_models[[ch]], df_dc)
  data.frame(channel = ch, chisq = t[["chisq"]], df = df_dc, p = t[["p"]],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

# Contrasts as time ratios: exp(-estimate) is level_1 / level_2.
dc_recovery_threshold_pairwise <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emmeans(dc_recovery_threshold_models[[ch]], ~ DC))))
  data.frame(channel = ch, contrast = s$contrast,
             ratio = exp(-s$estimate), p = s$p.value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

dc_recovery_threshold_variance_ratio_limit <- 4

dc_recovery_threshold_variance <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  m  <- dc_recovery_threshold_models[[ch]]
  a  <- subset(dc_recovery_threshold_model_data, channel == ch)
  re <- sqrt(as.numeric(unlist(m$D)))
  rs <- exp(as.numeric(m$phis))
  em <- subset(dc_recovery_threshold_emmeans, channel == ch)
  data.frame(
    channel     = ch,
    events      = sum(!a$censored),
    subjects    = length(unique(a$subjID)),
    re_sd       = re,
    resid_sd    = rs,
    ratio       = re / rs,
    max_emmean  = max(em$emmean),
    max_upperCL = max(em$upper.CL),
    degenerate  = (re / rs) > dc_recovery_threshold_variance_ratio_limit |
                  max(em$emmean) > dc_recovery_window_end_min,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

dc_recovery_threshold_dist_aic <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  a <- subset(dc_recovery_threshold_model_data, channel == ch)
  s <- Surv(a$y_plot, !a$censored)
  out <- vapply(c("lognormal", "loglogistic", "weibull", "exponential"), function(dd) {
    f <- try(survreg(s ~ DC, data = a, dist = dd), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(f, "try-error")) NA_real_ else AIC(f)
  }, numeric(1))
  data.frame(channel = ch, t(round(out, 1)),
             best = names(out)[which.min(out)],
             margin = round(diff(sort(out))[1], 1),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

dc_recovery_threshold_skew <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  sum((x - mean(x))^3) / (length(x) * sd(x)^3)
}

dc_recovery_threshold_residuals <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  a <- subset(dc_recovery_threshold_model_data, channel == ch & !censored)
  rbind(
    data.frame(channel = ch, scale = "raw",
               resid = as.numeric(resid(lmer(y_plot ~ DC + (1|subjID), data = a))),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(channel = ch, scale = "log",
               resid = as.numeric(resid(lmer(log(y_plot) ~ DC + (1|subjID), data = a))),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}))

dc_recovery_threshold_normality <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dc_figure_channels, function(ch) {
  rl <- dc_recovery_threshold_residuals$resid[
          dc_recovery_threshold_residuals$channel == ch &
          dc_recovery_threshold_residuals$scale == "log"]
  rr <- dc_recovery_threshold_residuals$resid[
          dc_recovery_threshold_residuals$channel == ch &
          dc_recovery_threshold_residuals$scale == "raw"]
  data.frame(channel = ch, n = length(rl),
             shapiro_log = signif(shapiro.test(rl)$p.value, 3),
             shapiro_raw = signif(shapiro.test(rr)$p.value, 3),
             skew_log    = round(dc_recovery_threshold_skew(rl), 2),
             skew_raw    = round(dc_recovery_threshold_skew(rr), 2),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

cat("AIC across AFT distributions (censoring respected):\n")
print(dc_recovery_threshold_dist_aic, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nNormality of residuals, uncensored recordings only (Shapiro-Wilk p):\n")
print(dc_recovery_threshold_normality, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nOmnibus effect of DC condition (likelihood-ratio test):\n")
print(data.frame(channel = dc_recovery_threshold_tests$channel,
                 chisq   = signif(dc_recovery_threshold_tests$chisq, 3),
                 df      = dc_recovery_threshold_tests$df,
                 p       = signif(dc_recovery_threshold_tests$p, 3)),
      row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nEstimated marginal means in minutes:\n")
print(data.frame(
  channel  = dc_recovery_threshold_emmeans$channel,
  DC       = dc_recovery_threshold_emmeans$DC,
  minutes  = round(dc_recovery_threshold_emmeans$emmean, 2),
  lower.CL = round(dc_recovery_threshold_emmeans$lower.CL, 2),
  upper.CL = round(dc_recovery_threshold_emmeans$upper.CL, 2)),
  row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nTukey-adjusted pairwise. Ratio > 1 = the FIRST level takes that many times as long:\n")
for (ch in dc_figure_channels) {
  p <- dc_recovery_threshold_pairwise[dc_recovery_threshold_pairwise$channel == ch, ]
  cat(" ", ch, "\n")
  print(data.frame(contrast = p$contrast,
                   ratio    = round(p$ratio, 2),
                   p        = signif(p$p, 3)), row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("\nVariance components and fit degeneracy (log-minutes):\n")
print(data.frame(
  channel     = dc_recovery_threshold_variance$channel,
  events      = dc_recovery_threshold_variance$events,
  subjects    = dc_recovery_threshold_variance$subjects,
  re_sd       = round(dc_recovery_threshold_variance$re_sd, 3),
  resid_sd    = round(dc_recovery_threshold_variance$resid_sd, 3),
  ratio       = round(dc_recovery_threshold_variance$ratio, 2),
  max_emmean  = round(dc_recovery_threshold_variance$max_emmean, 1),
  max_upperCL = round(dc_recovery_threshold_variance$max_upperCL, 1),
  degenerate  = dc_recovery_threshold_variance$degenerate), row.names = FALSE)
```

## The transform, seen rather than tabulated

Normal QQ plots of the recovery-time residuals on the raw and log scales.

```{r dc-recovery-threshold-qq, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5.5}
# Builds the QQ figure of recovery-time residuals, raw against log scale.
dc_recovery_threshold_qq_label <- function(ch, sc) {
  s <- dc_recovery_threshold_normality[dc_recovery_threshold_normality$channel == ch, ]
  p <- if (sc == "raw") s$shapiro_raw else s$shapiro_log
  k <- if (sc == "raw") s$skew_raw    else s$skew_log
  sprintf("%s - %s minutes\nShapiro p = %s, skew = %.2f, n = %d",
          dc_channel_short[[ch]], sc, format(p, digits = 2), k, s$n)
}

dc_recovery_threshold_qq_data <- dc_recovery_threshold_residuals
dc_recovery_threshold_qq_data$panel <- mapply(dc_recovery_threshold_qq_label,
                                              dc_recovery_threshold_qq_data$channel,
                                              dc_recovery_threshold_qq_data$scale)

dc_recovery_threshold_qq_data$panel <- factor(
  dc_recovery_threshold_qq_data$panel,
  levels = c(vapply(dc_figure_channels, dc_recovery_threshold_qq_label, character(1), "raw"),
             vapply(dc_figure_channels, dc_recovery_threshold_qq_label, character(1), "log")))

dc_recovery_threshold_qq_plot <-
  ggplot(dc_recovery_threshold_qq_data, aes(sample = resid)) +
  stat_qq_line(linewidth = line_baseline, colour = "grey45") +
  stat_qq(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.85, colour = "grey20") +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "Sample quantiles (model residual)",
       title = "Recovery-Time Residuals: Raw Against Log Scale",
       caption = paste0(
         "residuals from lmer(time ~ DC + (1|subjID)) on each scale, UNCENSORED recordings",
         " only - a censored recording has no residual\nto plot, so this is necessarily a",
         " complete-case check, and at the n stated on each panel it is a display rather",
         "\nthan a test. The stack at the lower left of the motor panels is the",
         " never-depressed recordings at the first probe.")) +
  manuscript_theme() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8.5, lineheight = 1.15),
        strip.background = element_blank())

dc_recovery_threshold_qq_plot
```
